changelog:
- Initial release of feishu-bridge for seamless delivery of OpenClaw reports and alerts to Feishu (Lark).
- Supports sending daily Portfolio Synergy and AI Frontier Sentinel/Job Tracker reports, plus urgent global news alerts.
- Enables VPN-free communication for users in China via Feishu webhook integration.
- Provides a simple Python script for easy message posting to the Feishu channel.
summary: Delivers OpenClaw reports and urgent alerts to Feishu via webhook for VPN-free access in China at scheduled times and on demand.
